plugins.prepareCmd:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
text = Path('pyproject.toml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
version = '${nextRelease.version}'
updated, count = re.subn(r'(?m)^version = ".*?"', f'version = "{version}"', text, count=1)
if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit('Failed to update pyproject.toml version')
Path('pyproject.toml').write_text(updated, encoding='utf-8')
PY

plugins.successComment: :tada: This release has been published successfully.
